fixtures.description: Australian seller legal identifier incorrectly uses the NZBN/GLN scheme.
NZ seller CompanyID uses scheme 0002 instead of the required NZBN scheme 0088.
AU buyer CompanyID uses scheme 0002 instead of the required ABN scheme 0151.
NZ buyer CompanyID uses scheme 0002 instead of the required NZBN scheme 0088.
CustomizationID does not start with the required urn:peppol:pint:billing-1@aunz-1 prefix.
ProfileID does not match the required urn:peppol:bis:billing business process value.
Neither a buyer reference nor an order reference is provided.
Item net price does not equal gross price minus price discount amount.
Prepaid amount is expressed with three fraction digits instead of the maximum two.
Both tax point date and tax point date code are provided; they are mutually exclusive.
Two PaymentTerms blocks are provided; invoice terms MUST occur at most once.
Credit transfer payment means (code 30) is provided without any payee financial account, so the payment account identifier is entirely absent.
Two TaxTotal elements each carrying tax subtotals are provided; only one tax total with subtotals is allowed.
A second TaxTotal without tax subtotals is provided, but no tax currency code is present to justify it.
Document level allowance has no GST tax category code.
Document level charge has no GST tax category code.
Invoice line item has a classified tax category whose tax scheme is not GST, so no GST classification code exists for the line.
Invoice line net amount does not equal quantity times unit price, beyond the 0.02 slack tolerance, while the stated line extension amount still matches document totals.
Document level allowance amount does not equal base amount times percentage, beyond the 0.02 slack tolerance.
Document level charge amount does not equal base amount times percentage, beyond the 0.02 slack tolerance.
Document level allowance has a percentage but no base amount; both or neither must be provided.
Document level charge has a percentage but no base amount; both or neither must be provided.
Invoice line item has two classified tax categories; exactly one is required.
Line document reference has a document type code other than 130, which is the only value allowed for a line document reference.
Amount due for payment is positive but neither a payment due date nor payment terms note is present.
PaymentMeans carries two payment references; the payment reference MUST occur at most once.
The document level allowance tax category code is "X", which is not one of the permitted UNCL5305 codes (E S Z G O).
The invoice period description code (tax point date code) is "99", which is not one of the permitted UNTDID 2005 subset codes (3, 35, 432).

The embedded document binary object uses mimeCode "application/xml", which is outside the aligned-ibrp-cl-04 subset (pdf, png, jpeg, csv, xlsx, ods) though it is allowed by the wider pint ibr-cl-24 list, isolating only the aligned rule.
Invoice has one Standard rated (S) line and one Exempt from tax (E) line, but the tax breakdown only contains the S subtotal, so the required E subtotal is missing.
Invoice line item is classified Exempt from tax (E) but its tax rate is 10, which must be 0 for E.
Document level allowance is classified Exempt from tax (E) but its tax rate is 10, which must be 0 for E.
Document level charge is classified Exempt from tax (E) but its tax rate is 10, which must be 0 for E.
The E tax breakdown taxable amount (120) does not equal the sum of Exempt line net amounts (100).
Invoice line uses Export (G) category but the tax breakdown carries the G subtotal split into two separate subtotal groups instead of exactly one.
Invoice line uses Export (G) category but declares a nonzero invoiced item tax rate (10) instead of 0.
Document level allowance uses Export (G) category but declares a nonzero allowance tax rate (10) instead of 0.
Document level charge uses Export (G) category but declares a nonzero charge tax rate (10) instead of 0.
G tax breakdown taxable amount (80.00) does not equal the sum of Export-category invoice line net amounts (100.00).
G tax breakdown declares a nonzero tax category tax amount (10.00) instead of the required 0, using a nonzero breakdown rate so the general tax-amount-consistency rule (051) is not violated.
Invoice line uses Not subject to tax (O) category but the tax breakdown carries the O subtotal split into two separate subtotal groups instead of exactly one.
Invoice line uses Not subject to tax (O) category but declares an invoiced item tax rate (0), which must be absent entirely for O.
Document level allowance uses Not subject to tax (O) category but declares an allowance tax rate (0), which must be absent entirely for O.
Document level charge uses Not subject to tax (O) category but declares a charge tax rate (0), which must be absent entirely for O.
O tax breakdown taxable amount (80.00) does not equal the sum of Not-subject-to-tax invoice line net amounts (100.00).
O tax breakdown declares a nonzero tax category tax amount (10.00) instead of the required 0, using a nonzero breakdown rate so the general tax-amount-consistency rule (051) is not violated.
Document has an O tax breakdown plus an extra Export (G) breakdown group with no supporting line, allowance, or charge, violating the O-exclusivity rule on breakdown groups.
Invoice has one Standard rated (S) line and one Zero rated (Z) line, but the tax breakdown only contains the Z subtotal, so the required S subtotal is missing.
Invoice line item is classified Standard rated (S) but its tax rate is 0, which must be greater than zero for S.
Document level allowance is classified Standard rated (S) but its tax rate is 0, which must be greater than zero for S.
Document level charge is classified Standard rated (S) but its tax rate is 0, which must be greater than zero for S.
The S tax breakdown taxable amount (120) does not equal the sum of Standard rated line net amounts (100).
The S (Standard rated) tax breakdown carries a tax exemption reason text, which is forbidden for the S category.
Seller declares two PartyTaxScheme/CompanyID entries under the GST tax scheme; only one Seller GST identifier is allowed.
Seller declares two PartyTaxScheme/CompanyID entries under a non-GST tax scheme (income tax); only one other Seller tax registration is allowed.
AdditionalDocumentReference has no DocumentTypeCode (a plain supporting document reference) but its ID carries a schemeID attribute, only permitted when DocumentTypeCode is 130.
Invoice has one Standard rated (S) line and one Zero rated (Z) line, but the tax breakdown only contains the S subtotal, so the required Z subtotal is missing.
Invoice line item is classified Zero rated (Z) but its tax rate is 10, which must be 0 for Z.
Document level allowance is classified Zero rated (Z) but its tax rate is 10, which must be 0 for Z.
Document level charge is classified Zero rated (Z) but its tax rate is 10, which must be 0 for Z.
The Z tax breakdown taxable amount (120) does not equal the sum of Zero rated line net amounts (100).
The Z (Zero rated) tax breakdown carries a tax exemption reason text, which is forbidden for the Z category.
Invoice omits both cbc:InvoiceTypeCode and cbc:CreditNoteTypeCode, so the invoice type code is missing.
Seller PartyLegalEntity omits cbc:RegistrationName, so the Seller name is missing.
Buyer PartyLegalEntity omits cbc:RegistrationName, so the Buyer name is missing.
Seller Party omits cac:PostalAddress entirely, so the Seller postal address is missing.
Seller PostalAddress omits cac:Country/cbc:IdentificationCode, so the Seller country code is missing.
Buyer Party omits cac:PostalAddress entirely, so the Buyer postal address is missing.
Buyer PostalAddress omits cac:Country/cbc:IdentificationCode, so the Buyer country code is missing.
Invoice has a PayeeParty distinct from the Seller (PartyIdentification present) but no PartyName/Name, so the Payee name is missing.
Invoice has a TaxRepresentativeParty (with address and PartyTaxScheme/CompanyID) but no PartyName/Name, so the Seller tax representative name is missing.
Invoice has a TaxRepresentativeParty (with name and PartyTaxScheme/CompanyID) but omits PostalAddress entirely, so the Seller tax representative postal address is missing.
Invoice has a TaxRepresentativeParty (with name, address and PartyTaxScheme/CompanyID) but the PostalAddress omits Country/IdentificationCode, so the tax representative country code is missing.
InvoiceLine InvoicedQuantity omits the unitCode attribute, so the invoiced quantity unit of measure code is missing.
InvoiceLine Item omits cbc:Name, so the Item name is missing.
InvoiceLine Price PriceAmount is negative, with matching negative line and document totals so only the negative-price sign check fires.
Invoice line Price/AllowanceCharge has a negative BaseAmount (Item gross price), with net price arithmetic against Amount kept internally consistent so aligned-ibrp-004 stays satisfied.
Document-level InvoicePeriod has an EndDate earlier than its StartDate.
Invoice line InvoicePeriod has an EndDate earlier than its StartDate.
Document-level allowance (ChargeIndicator=false) has an Amount but neither AllowanceChargeReason nor AllowanceChargeReasonCode.
Invoice line allowance (ChargeIndicator=false) has an Amount but neither AllowanceChargeReason nor AllowanceChargeReasonCode.
Invoice line charge (ChargeIndicator=true) has an Amount but neither AllowanceChargeReason nor AllowanceChargeReasonCode.
Invoice line Item AdditionalItemProperty has a Name but no Value.
Seller tax representative party is present (name and address) but has no PartyTaxScheme/CompanyID tax identifier.
Delivery/DeliveryLocation/Address is present without a Country/IdentificationCode.
Seller EndpointID (electronic address) is present without a schemeID attribute.
Buyer EndpointID (electronic address) is present without a schemeID attribute.
Invoice line Item StandardItemIdentification/ID is present without a schemeID attribute.
Invoice line Item CommodityClassification/ItemClassificationCode is present without a listID attribute.
Two separate PaymentMeans blocks each carry a CardAccount, exceeding the document-wide maximum of one Payment Card account.
Two separate PaymentMeans blocks each carry a PaymentMandate, exceeding the document-wide maximum of one Payment Mandate.
Supplier PartyIdentification carries a scheme 0088 (GLN) identifier whose final digit fails the GS1 check-digit algorithm.
Supplier PartyIdentification carries a scheme 0192 (Norwegian organization number) identifier that fails the mod11 checksum.
Supplier PartyIdentification carries a scheme 0184 (Danish CVR) identifier that does not start with the required 'DK' prefix.
AdditionalDocumentReference with DocumentTypeCode 130 (invoiced object) also carries an Attachment, which ibr-071 forbids.
AdditionalDocumentReference with DocumentTypeCode 130 (invoiced object) also carries a DocumentDescription, which ibr-072 forbids.
IssueDate carries a timezone offset suffix, a lexically valid xs:date that is not the required 10-character YYYY-MM-DD format.
AdditionalDocumentReference attachment's EmbeddedDocumentBinaryObject has a mimeCode but no filename attribute.
TaxCurrencyCode is set to the same value as DocumentCurrencyCode, which ibr-077 forbids when TaxCurrencyCode is provided.
Two AdditionalDocumentReference elements with DocumentTypeCode 130 (invoiced object) appear at document level; only one is allowed.
Document-level Note element is present but empty; ibr-079 forbids empty elements anywhere in the document.
AccountingCustomerParty/Party has no EndpointID (Buyer electronic address), which ibr-080 requires.
AccountingSupplierParty/Party has no EndpointID (Seller electronic address), which ibr-081 requires.
cac:Price/cac:AllowanceCharge has ChargeIndicator true (a charge), which ibr-083 forbids; only allowances are permitted at price level.
TaxCurrencyCode tax total is negative while the DocumentCurrencyCode tax total is positive; ibr-084 requires both to share the same operational sign.
Line-level InvoicePeriod StartDate falls before the document-level InvoicePeriod StartDate, which ibr-085 forbids.
Line-level InvoicePeriod EndDate falls after the document-level InvoicePeriod EndDate, which ibr-086 forbids.
Price/BaseQuantity is -1 (not positive), which ibr-087 forbids; totals kept arithmetically consistent so no calculation rule co-fires.
Price/BaseQuantity unitCode (KGM) differs from the line's InvoicedQuantity unitCode (EA), which ibr-088 forbids.
The invoice line carries two cac:DocumentReference elements with DocumentTypeCode 130 (invoiced object); only one is allowed per line.

Credit note (no cac:ProjectReference element in the CreditNote XSD) with two AdditionalDocumentReference elements carrying DocumentTypeCode 50 (project reference); only one project reference is allowed.
A line carries a DespatchLineReference/DocumentReference while a document-level DespatchDocumentReference is also present; ibr-092 forbids having both.
A cac:PrepaidPayment with a paid amount is present but LegalMonetaryTotal/PrepaidAmount is missing, which ibr-093 forbids.
Two cac:ContractDocumentReference elements appear at document level; ibr-094 allows the contract reference to occur at most once.
Two cac:ReceiptDocumentReference elements appear at document level; ibr-095 allows the receiving advice reference to occur at most once.
Two cac:DespatchDocumentReference elements appear at document level; ibr-096 allows the despatch advice reference to occur at most once.
Two cac:InvoicePeriod elements appear at document level; ibr-097 allows the invoicing period to occur at most once.
Seller Party has two PartyName/Name elements, violating the maximum-once cardinality for the seller trader name.
Seller has two PartyLegalEntity blocks each carrying a CompanyLegalForm, violating the maximum-once cardinality for seller additional legal information.
Buyer Party has two PartyTaxScheme blocks each carrying a CompanyID, violating the maximum-once cardinality for the buyer tax identifier.
Payee (different from Seller) has two non-SEPA PartyIdentification/ID elements, violating the maximum-once cardinality for the payee identifier.
Payee (different from Seller) has two PartyLegalEntity blocks each carrying a CompanyID, violating the maximum-once cardinality for the payee legal identifier.
Invoice has two cac:Delivery blocks, violating the maximum-once cardinality for Deliver to information.
Delivery party has two PartyName/Name elements, violating the maximum-once cardinality for the deliver-to party name.
Invoice line has two OrderLineReference/LineID elements, violating the maximum-once cardinality for the referenced purchase order line identifier.
Invoice line has two InvoicePeriod blocks, violating the maximum-once cardinality for the invoice line period.
Invoice line Price has two AllowanceCharge/Amount elements, violating the maximum-once cardinality for the item price discount.
Buyer Party has two PartyName/Name elements, violating the maximum-once cardinality for the buyer trader name.
Buyer PartyIdentification carries a scheme 0208 (Belgian enterprise number) identifier that fails the modulus-97 checksum, on an otherwise ordinary AU invoice.
Buyer PartyIdentification carries a scheme 0201 (Italian IPA code) identifier that fails the required checksum format, on an otherwise ordinary AU invoice.
Buyer PartyIdentification carries a scheme 0210 (Italian Codice Fiscale) identifier that fails the required checksum format, on an otherwise ordinary AU invoice.
Buyer PartyIdentification carries a scheme 0211 (Italian Partita IVA) identifier with an IT prefix that fails the check-digit algorithm, on an otherwise ordinary AU invoice.
Buyer PartyLegalEntity CompanyID uses scheme 0151 (ABN) with an 11-digit value that fails the modulus-89 ABN checksum.
LegalMonetaryTotal TaxExclusiveAmount uses currencyID NZD while the document currency is AUD, violating the currency consistency rule.
Buyer PartyIdentification carries a scheme 0007 (Swedish organization number) identifier that is not a 10-digit number, on an otherwise ordinary AU invoice.
InvoiceTypeCode 999, not in the UNTDID 1001 invoice/credit-note subset.
AdditionalDocumentReference with DocumentTypeCode 130 has an ID schemeID of ZZZZ, not a UNTDID 1153 code.
Buyer PartyIdentification ID schemeID 9999, an unknown ISO 6523 ICD code (boundary: unknown scheme).

PayeeParty PartyLegalEntity CompanyID schemeID 9999, an unknown ISO 6523 ICD code; PayeeParty used instead of buyer/supplier so the AU/NZ ABN/NZBN alignment rules (which pin CompanyID scheme to 0151/0088) do not also fire.
Line item CommodityClassification ItemClassificationCode listID ZZ, not in the UNTDID 7143 list.
Buyer PostalAddress Country IdentificationCode ZZ, a plausible-but-absent ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (boundary case).
Export invoice line Item OriginCountry IdentificationCode ZZ, a plausible-but-absent ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (boundary case).
PaymentMeans PaymentMeansCode 999, not in the UNCL4461 code list.
Document-level allowance (ChargeIndicator false) AllowanceChargeReasonCode 999, not in the UNCL5189 code list.
Document-level charge (ChargeIndicator true) AllowanceChargeReasonCode 999, not in the UNCL7161 code list.
Line item StandardItemIdentification ID schemeID 9999, an unknown ISO 6523 ICD code.
InvoicedQuantity unitCode ZZZ, a bogus code not in UN/ECE Recommendation 20 with Rec 21 extension (boundary/bogus unit case).

Buyer EndpointID schemeID 9999, an unknown CEF EAS scheme (boundary: unknown scheme). No retired/removed EAS code variant added: eas.gc carries no deprecation markers, so a second 'retired code' variant could not be identified.
Delivery DeliveryLocation ID schemeID 9999, an unknown ISO 6523 ICD code.
LegalMonetaryTotal/LineExtensionAmount (105.00) does not equal the sum of InvoiceLine net amounts (100.00); downstream totals compensated so only co-10 fails.
LegalMonetaryTotal/AllowanceTotalAmount (8.00) does not equal the sum of document-level AllowanceCharge amounts with ChargeIndicator=false (5.00); downstream totals compensated so only co-11 fails.
LegalMonetaryTotal/ChargeTotalAmount (12.00) does not equal the sum of document-level AllowanceCharge amounts with ChargeIndicator=true (5.00); downstream totals compensated so only co-12 fails.
LegalMonetaryTotal/TaxExclusiveAmount (105.00) does not equal LineExtensionAmount (100.00) with no allowances/charges present; TaxInclusiveAmount/PayableAmount compensated so only co-13 fails.
TaxTotal/TaxAmount (12.00) does not equal the sum of the two TaxSubtotal/TaxAmount values (10.00 + 0.00); LegalMonetaryTotal totals compensated so only co-14 fails.
LegalMonetaryTotal/TaxInclusiveAmount (120.00) does not equal TaxExclusiveAmount + TaxTotal/TaxAmount (110.00); PayableAmount compensated so only co-15 fails.
LegalMonetaryTotal/PayableAmount (95.00) does not equal TaxInclusiveAmount (110.00) - PrepaidAmount (20.00); all upstream totals internally consistent so only co-16 fails.
Invoice-level InvoicePeriod (ibg-14) present with only a Description child, no StartDate/EndDate/DescriptionCode.
InvoiceLine-level InvoicePeriod (ibg-26) present with only a Description child, no StartDate/EndDate.
Invoice PaymentTerms carries two cbc:Note elements, exceeding the maximum of one payment terms note.
Invoice buyer party carries two cac:PartyIdentification/cbc:ID elements, exceeding the maximum of one buyer identifier.
Invoice PayeeParty (different from the Seller) carries two cac:PartyName/cbc:Name elements, exceeding the maximum of one payee name.
Document-level allowance (ChargeIndicator false) carries two cbc:AllowanceChargeReason elements, exceeding the maximum of one allowance reason.
Document-level charge (ChargeIndicator true) carries two cbc:AllowanceChargeReason elements, exceeding the maximum of one charge reason.
Exempt TaxSubtotal's TaxCategory carries two cbc:TaxExemptionReason elements, exceeding the maximum of one VAT exemption reason text.
AdditionalDocumentReference carries two cbc:DocumentDescription elements, exceeding the maximum of one supporting document description.
InvoiceLine carries two cbc:Note elements, exceeding the maximum of one invoice line note.
InvoiceLine Item's ClassifiedTaxCategory carries two cbc:TaxExemptionReason elements, exceeding the maximum of one invoiced item tax exemption reason text.
Invoice InvoicePeriod carries two cbc:DescriptionCode elements (value tax point date), exceeding the maximum of one occurrence.
InvoiceLine Item carries two cbc:Description elements, exceeding the maximum of one occurrence.
Document carries two cbc:Note elements, exceeding the maximum of one occurrence.
Document carries two cac:OriginatorDocumentReference/cbc:ID elements (tender or lot reference), exceeding the maximum of one occurrence.
Seller PostalAddress carries two cac:AddressLine/cbc:Line elements, exceeding the maximum of one occurrence.
Buyer PostalAddress carries two cac:AddressLine/cbc:Line elements, exceeding the maximum of one occurrence.
TaxRepresentativeParty PostalAddress carries two cac:AddressLine/cbc:Line elements, exceeding the maximum of one occurrence; a valid PartyTaxScheme/CompanyID is included so only ibr-sr-55 fires.
Delivery/DeliveryLocation/Address carries two cac:AddressLine/cbc:Line elements, exceeding the maximum of one occurrence.
Seller cac:PartyTaxScheme is present but omits cbc:CompanyID, violating the requirement that a company identifier exist in the party tax scheme class.
PaymentMeans/PayeeFinancialAccount/FinancialInstitutionBranch/Address carries two cac:AddressLine/cbc:Line elements, exceeding the maximum of one occurrence.
PaymentTerms carries two cbc:PaymentMeansID elements, exceeding the maximum of one occurrence.

Document-level AllowanceCharge/TaxCategory carries two cbc:TaxExemptionReason elements, exceeding the maximum of one occurrence; the allowance uses the same Standard-rated (S) category as the tax breakdown so no aligned tax-category rule also fires.
CustomizationID retains the required 'urn:peppol:pint:billing-1@aunz-1' prefix but appends a trailing '*' wildcard character, which ibr-sr-63 forbids.
Well-formed invoice with a DOCTYPE declaring an external entity referenced in cbc:Note; preflight bans DOCTYPE outright, proving external entities are never resolved.
Zero-byte file; preflight rejects it as empty before any parsing.
Valid-shaped invoice padded with repeated Note elements to ~110 KiB, exceeding the 100 KiB preflight harness cap.
Valid-shaped invoice cut off mid-element inside AccountingSupplierParty; fails XML well-formedness before schema validation.
An XML invoice with an unclosed ID element.
XML prolog declares encoding UTF-16 but the file bytes are UTF-8 text; preflight rejects any declared encoding that is not UTF-8.
Root element named Invoice but declaring the Order-2 namespace; preflight rejects the root/namespace mismatch.
Minimal well-formed UBL Order document; preflight only accepts Invoice or CreditNote roots, so this is rejected as unsupported.
Well-formed credit note with the document-level cbc:ID removed; the UBL 2.1 CreditNote XSD requires it.
Well-formed invoice with cbc:IssueDate placed before cbc:ID, violating the UBL 2.1 Invoice XSD required sequence order.
cbc:IssueDate set to 2026-13-45, an out-of-range month and day that fails xsd:date lexical rules.
Well-formed invoice with cbc:IssueDate removed; the UBL 2.1 Invoice XSD requires it.
A made-up cbc:FrobnicationCode element inserted at document level, which the UBL 2.1 Invoice XSD does not allow.
AU credit note with a document-level allowance and a billing reference to the original invoice.
Australian credit note reversing one standard-rated line.
NZ credit note with one standard-rated 15% GST line and a billing reference to the original invoice.
AU invoice with a document-level allowance and charge (percentage + base amount) plus a line-level allowance and a line-level charge.
AU invoice with full contact details for both parties, buyer/seller trading names, additional party identifiers, and a seller tax representative party.
Accepts the 1.1.2 code-list additions: EAS 0244 endpoint scheme, ICD 0241 party identifier scheme, currency CNH, and updated ISO 3166 BS as origin country.
AU invoice with a tax category E (Exempt from tax) line and matching single tax breakdown.
AU invoice for exported goods using tax category G (Export) at 0%, document currency remains AUD.

AU invoice with seller/buyer/standard item identifiers, commodity classification, origin country, an additional item property, a price base quantity other than 1, and varied unit codes (HUR, KGM, DAY).
AU invoice with four lines, mixed S (10%) and Z (0%) GST categories, and two tax subtotals.
AU negative invoice: negative InvoicedQuantity with non-negative PriceAmount, negative line and document totals.
AU invoice entirely out of scope of GST (tax category O): no Percent element, single O tax breakdown, tax exemption reason present, no other category.
AU invoice with credit transfer payment means (account name/id/branch), a payment id, and a payment terms note.
AU invoice with a prepaid amount, a negative payable rounding amount, and a due date.
AU invoice with a line Price/AllowanceCharge showing gross price and per-unit discount, where PriceAmount equals BaseAmount minus Amount.

AU invoice with order/sales order, contract, project, despatch, and receipt references, buyer accounting cost, an embedded base64 PDF supporting document, and an invoiced-object AdditionalDocumentReference (DocumentTypeCode 130, schemeID HWB).
Australian invoice with one standard-rated 10% GST line.
Australian invoice with one zero-rated GST line.
NZ invoice with delivery party/location/date, a document invoice period, and a line-level invoice period.
New Zealand invoice with one standard-rated 15% GST line.
NZ seller invoice priced in USD (DocumentCurrencyCode) with TaxCurrencyCode NZD and a second TaxTotal without subtotals carrying the tax amount in NZD.
